meta.note: The five laws of the Temporal OS.

laws.authority_of_time: The Kernel is sole arbitrator of the Physical Timeline; execution quantized into Temporal Slices; sync only at Temporal Boundaries
laws.physical_territory: Memory is Physical Territory; access needs explicit Temporal Grant; overcommitment is a violation of reality
laws.causality: IPC is causal and synchronous; state transitions atomic and observable; cause precedes consequence in the log
laws.finite_existence: All objects have lifecycles; all resources bounded and finite; implicit/infinite authority does not exist
laws.shared_perception: Consistent system clock; relative priority = subjective slice of the timeline

system_role: The five laws stand over the engine: finite budgets (15MB), atomic transitions, causal logs, no infinite authority — the Contract already describes the Archive.
